lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Ah huh, come on, now where was she shot? Be honest here.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Before she was put in the truck or after?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: So she's in the truck and that's when he shoots her? (Brendan nods “yes”) How many times? (pause) Remember weeee got a number of shell casings that we found in that garage. I'm not gonna tell ya how many but you need to tell me how many times, about, that she was shot.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: We know you shot her too. Is that right? (Brendan shakes head “no”) Then who did?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I didn't even touch the gun.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: OK. How many times did Steven shoot her?

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: And she was in the back of the truck or the SUV that whole time that he shot her?

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: She was on the, the garage floor.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: She was on the garage floor, OK.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: That makes sense. Now we believe you.
